viewsWelcome.0.contents:
No courses found.

Courses are loaded from extensions (contributes.cadsTutorCourses), /opt/cads-tutor/courses, ~/.cads-tutor/courses and <workspace>/.cads-tutor/courses.
[Reload courses](command:cads.tutor.reloadCourses)

configuration.properties.cadsTutor.autoO: Open the tutor panel with the first step on first start (no session yet).
configuration.properties.cadsTutor.langu: Course content language (auto = VS Code display language).
configuration.properties.cadsTutor.check: On save, re-run the current step's local checks and, with an LLM configured, request a proactive check-in.
configuration.properties.cadsTutor.build: Task label used by 'build' checks without an explicit label.
walkthroughs.0.title: CaDS Firmware Lab: getting started
walkthroughs.0.description: Connect the board, build, flash, debug - the path to your first firmware build.
walkthroughs.0.steps.0.title: 1. Connect the board
walkthroughs.0.steps.0.description:
Connect the ST-Link over USB and grant access in the browser.
[Connect board](command:cads.board.connect)
walkthroughs.0.steps.1.title: 2. Build the firmware
walkthroughs.0.steps.1.description:
Run the build task (Terminal → Run Build Task).
[Run build](command:workbench.action.tasks.build)
walkthroughs.0.steps.2.title: 3. Flash
walkthroughs.0.steps.2.description:
Write the binary to the board.
[Flash](command:cads.board.flash)
walkthroughs.0.steps.3.title: 4. Debug
walkthroughs.0.steps.3.description:
Start a debug session with F5 and stop at a breakpoint.
[Start debugging](command:workbench.action.debug.start)
walkthroughs.0.steps.4.title: 5. Continue in the tutor
walkthroughs.0.steps.4.description:
Open the guided course with its tasks and checks.
[Open tutor](command:cads.tutor.open)
